_about: Files from Figma's own 'Export' that cannot be matched to a frame by name alone. Key = the PNG's name without .png. catalog_exports.py applies these first.

My Account - Payments Methods-1.name: My Account - Password Manager
My Account - Payments Methods-1.note: In Figma this frame is named 'My Account - Payments Methods' (a copy-paste slip by the designer) but it shows the Password Manager screen. Figma added -1 to the file name because two frames share a name.
